about: The introitus of the formulary “Second Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Remember Thy tender mercies, O Lord, and Thy mercy, which are from of old; let not our enemies ever rule over us. Deliver us, O God of Israel, from all our tribulations. To Thee, O Lord, have I lifted up my soul; in Thee, O my God, I put my trust; let me not be ashamed. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Remember Thy tender mercies, O Lord, and Thy mercy, which are from of old; let not our enemies ever rule over us. Deliver us, O God of Israel, from all our tribulations.
